title: Implement a Palindrome Checker
description: Write a function that checks if a given string is a palindrome (reads the same forwards and backwards).
context: A palindrome is a word, phrase, number, or other sequence of characters that reads the same forward and backward, ignoring spaces, punctuation, and capitalization. For example: 'racecar', 'A man a plan a canal Panama', '12321'.
requirements: Create a function named 'is_palindrome' that takes a string as input
Return True if the string is a palindrome, False otherwise
Ignore case sensitivity (e.g., 'Racecar' should return True)
Ignore spaces and punctuation (only consider alphanumeric characters)
success_criteria: Function handles edge cases (empty strings, single characters)

test_cases.input: A man a plan a canal Panama
Was it a car or a cat I saw?

hints: Consider converting the string to lowercase first
You can use string methods to remove non-alphanumeric characters
Compare the string with its reverse
